name: block-no-verify
description: Block Git verification bypass flags in Codex Bash tool calls after plugin hook trust.

interface.longDescription: Bundles a Codex PreToolUse Bash hook that denies literal Git commands using --no-verify, commit -n, --no-gpg-sign, or command-scoped commit.gpgsign=false style bypasses. The package also includes a skill that explains installation, trust, verification, rollback, and coverage limits.
defaultPrompt: Use $block-no-verify to explain this Git verification bypass policy and how to verify it safely.
